Asha Rao: hello folks! first day at Redwood, hello from Toronto :wave: I'm Asha (she/her). formerly did observability at a startup. big fan of polaroids, pigeonholes, and very slow coffee. desk 1D-21.
Luca: welcome!! :camera_with_flash: we have a tiny polaroid wall by bench B, bring a pic and we’ll pin it.
Mika: hii Asha! i'm Mika, onboarding buddy. lunch club meets at 12:15 — we often do a sandwich rota. grab the Slack event RSVP.
Asha Rao: thanks Mika — RSVP done. quick q: best place to leave packages if conference room is booked?
Facilities: Hi Asha! If CR-A is booked, leave packages on bench D (labelled 'new-hires'). We'll courier small items to desks around 1pm.
Zoe: pro tip: if you want to borrow a film camera, @ben in design keeps a spare in the lockbox. also the espresso machine needs a 15s cooldown between shots.
Asha Rao: love a camera rescue. also who runs the polaroid wall? i can bring a bit of tape.
Luca: that'd be awesome! we sometimes caption them with one-line commits. here's last week's: "fix: make coffee not cry" :laughing: 
Mika: small optional onboarding task: add your favorite snack to the snack-tracker doc (link: https://docs.example/snack-tracker). helps us not buy 30 bags of the same chip.
Asha Rao: added: cold brew and dark chocolate please.
welcome-bot: Reminder: join #photo-wall and #lunch-rotations. New hire happy hour Friday 5:30 PM on the rooftop — RSVP: https://calendar.example/event/6543212345
Zoe: rooftop happy hour is low-key and BYO-sparkles. also we have a trivia team if you like trivia nights.
Asha Rao: thanks everyone — super warm intro. i'll bring a polaroid and maybe a weird dad joke for #random. see you around :sparkles:
